name: Chamonix & the French Alps
about: Winter (Dec–Mar) is prime skiing and extreme freeride terrain; summer (Jun–Sep) is prime hiking, including the multi-day Tour du Mont Blanc; the shoulder mud seasons see many lifts and trails close.
overview: The birthplace of modern mountaineering, beneath Mont Blanc — extreme skiing, the famous Tour du Mont Blanc trek, and the Alps' most serious adventure sports.
costOverview: Even a casual café meal runs high here, and the marquee activities — the Aiguille du Midi, guided glacier hikes, ski passes — push costs further still.

hiking.label: Summer trail access, including the Tour du Mont Blanc
